title: 26 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj performs the murti pratishtha of the Rajkot mandir
story: On this day in 1998, Pramukh Swami Maharaj performed the murti pratishtha of the new BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Rajkot.

options.headline: Prabodhini Ekadashi 2001 in Gondal
options.story:
The day marks Dev Uthi ekadashi, Shriji Maharaj's diksha day (202nd) and appointment as head of the fellowship (201st), Pramukh Swami Maharaj's initiation into parshad (63rd years), beginning of Tulsi Vivah and end of Chaturmas.

When Swamishri arrived in the Rang Mandap for darshan of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj the sadhus chanted the 'upavit' mantras before a mock diksha scene where a cut-out murti of Swamishri was placed near the gurus' murtis.

In the evening at 6.00 pm, an Annakut of fresh vegetables was aranged before Thakorji. Swamishri performed the arti and blessed the assembly of devotees. Swamishri spoke about the sanctity the vegetables had acquired by virtue of their having been offered to God. Swamishri took hold of a brinjal, then a white raddish and finally a 'galka' in hand and spoke about their virtues.

During the Kartiki Purnima assembly. After arti, Bapa explains, by taking a brinjal, white radish and 'galka' in hand, that the vegetables have become consecrated through the association of Thakorji. Gives a consecrated vegetable to a child. Morning puja on Dev Diwali: An Annakut of fresh vegetables with Bapa's seat arranged between a large scale. Prays to Akshar Purushottam Maharaj. Performs murti pratishtha rituals. Observes the catering arrangements of prasad. Addresses the Kartiki Purnima assembly of more than 15,000 bhaktas. Performs Shangar arti on Kartik Purnima day. Performs the pratishtha arti. Blesses the assembly. Performs pratishtha of murtis for mandir in Bhatpura village. Bapa and bhaktas perform arti in the assembly hall to commemorate the 199th arti anniversary. Performs pratishtha of murtis for mandir in Khanpur village. Performs the pratishtha arti of murtis for both mandirs. Performs pratishtha of murtis for mandirs in Bharkunda village. During the Kartiki Purnima assembly. Performs arti to celebrate its 199th anniversary. During the assembly. Blesses the bhaktas. Performs the customary arti in a dried coconut cup.

options.headline: Dev Diwali 2004 in Bochasan
options.story:
For the celebration of Dev Diwali an annakut had been arranged before the murtis of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj in the morning.

The festival assembly for Dev Diwali or Kartik Punam commenced immediately after Swamishri’s puja. Speeches by various sadhus followed. After Ishwarcharan Swami’s speech BAPS children and youths performed a traditional dance, “Anandno avasariyo re meheki rahyo…” Thereafter Dr. Swami and Mahant Swami addressed the assembly. This was followed by a garlanding ceremony by senior sadhus to honour and welcome Swamishri. A mantra-pushpanjali ritual was performed by 10,000 devotees to honour and offer respects to Swamishri. Finally, in his blessings, Swamishri said, “Shriji Maharaj has explained in the Vachanamrut the reason for celebrating festivals. Whosoever may remember a festival on his death bed will remember God. This will bless his soul with the attainment of the divine abode of God. So a little remembrance of God blesses a soul with redemption… Through festivals one’s morals are strengthened and many give up addictions… When Shriji Maharaj transformed the terrifying criminal called Joban Pagi peace prevailed in society. This is a great service to society…”

Performs arti of Thakorji on Dev Diwali. Performs arti of Thakorji on Dev Diwali. Descends the mandir steps after Thakorji's darshan. Leaves the stage after performing his morning puja. Kishores on stage with Bapa after performing a traditional dance. During the assembly.

options.headline: During mahayagna rituals
options.story:
The sacred thread for the driver

Before the meal, Punyanilaydas Swami, speaking of an ordinary devotee who had come to today's meetings, said, "Swami! He is a driver. His name is Jayantibhai Patel and his village is Khankuva. Today you placed your hand on his head and he was so pleased, so pleased, that he kept saying, 'I am blessed... I am blessed...'"

While this was being talked about, the attendant sadhu asked Mahant Swami Maharaj, "Do you wish to give anyone the sacred thread tied in this yagna?" He suggested the names of one or two sadhus, but Swamishri said, "No, to that driver!"

The sadhus' amazement knew no bounds. Swamishri had written this extremely rare sanctified gift into the driver's lot! But later the reason came to be known: Jayantibhai had made a wish that it would be good if he got some sanctified item of Swamishri's. And Swamishri fulfilled his wish.

During mahayagna rituals. Performs morning puja. Performs his morning puja. Reads the Shikshapatri. In darshan of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. Blesses bhaktas by showering rice grains. Greets spiritual leaders. Offers thal to Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. Offers mantra pushpanjali. Gives diksha mantra to newly initiated sadhus and blesses them. Greets all with 'Jai Swaminarayan'. Blesses family members of newly initiated sadhus. Honored with a garland. Greets bhaktas with 'Jai Swaminarayan'. Offers thal to Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj and Brahmaswarup Yogiji Maharaj. Senior sadhus and bhaktas offer mantra pushpanjali. Blesses an invited guest. Sanctifies a shawl. Arrives to perform the main rituals of the mahayagna. Performs diksha rituals. Bapa and senior sadhus perform arti. During the diksha cremony. Greets newly initiated sadhus with 'Jai Swaminarayan'. Perfroms diksha rituals. Blesses the assembly. Performs mahayagna rituals. Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami blesses parshads to be initiated as sadhus. Pujya Kothari Swami blesses parshads to be initiated as sadhus. Fathers of the parshads participate in mahapuja rituals. Mothers of the parshads participate in mahapuja rituals. Pujya Kothari Swami addresses the evening satsang assembly. Parshads to be initiated as sadhus perform diksha rituals. Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami blesses newly initiated sadhus. Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami blesses newly initiated sadhus. Pujya Kothari Swami puts on the 'paagh' for newly initiated sadhus. Fathers of the newly initiated sadhus during the diksha ceremony. Mothers of the newly initiated sadhus during the diksha ceremony. Newly initiated sadhus with Bapa.
